topic_title: Learning Basic HTML with Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat
goal: Learn how to use Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat to understand HTML basics and generate working page examples
technical_facts: HTML stands for HyperText Markup Language
HTML is the standard language used to build web pages
The h1 element defines the primary heading on a web page
The h2 element creates subsection headings

tasks.description: Start from the Copilot home page and ask a foundational question to learn what HTML is

steps.action: Open the Copilot chat box from the Copilot home page
steps.details: This is the starting point for the demo
steps.expected_outcome: The chat box is ready to accept a question

steps.action: Type "What is HTML?" into the chat box
steps.details: This is usually the first question to ask if you're completely new to HTML
steps.expected_outcome: Copilot responds: "HTML stands for HyperText Markup Language. It is the standard language used to build web pages."

tasks.description: Ask Copilot to produce a working HTML example after learning the definition

steps.action: Type "Show me a simple HTML example." into the chat box
steps.details: Copilot can provide example code in addition to explanations
steps.expected_outcome:
Copilot generates a complete basic HTML page structure: My First Page

Hello World

This is my first webpage.

tasks.description: Dig deeper into the generated example by asking Copilot to explain specific elements

steps.action: Type "Explain the h1 element." into the chat box
steps.details: Used to understand the purpose of a specific tag from the generated example
steps.expected_outcome: Copilot responds: "The h1 element defines the primary heading on a web page."

steps.action: Ask about the difference between h1 and h2 elements
steps.details: A commonly asked follow-up question once the basics are understood
steps.expected_outcome: Copilot responds: "The h1 element represents the primary page heading. h2 elements create subsection headings."

tasks.description: Build on the basics to generate more complete examples and understand how the code works

steps.action: Ask Copilot to generate a complete sample web page using headings and paragraphs
steps.details: Applies the headings and paragraph concepts covered earlier
steps.expected_outcome: Copilot generates a fuller HTML page example combining headings and paragraphs

steps.action: Ask Copilot to explain why the generated code works
steps.details: You can continue asking follow-up questions until you understand each element
steps.expected_outcome: Copilot provides an explanation of the code's structure and behavior
